
`r ct` {data-navmenu="DE by contrast"}
=====================================

```{r}
d     <- de[[ct]]
ct_row <- contrasts[contrasts$contrast == ct, ]
n_up   <- sum(d$direction == "Up")
n_down <- sum(d$direction == "Down")
```

Row {data-height=150}
-------------------------------------

### Up in `r ct_row$treatment` vs `r ct_row$control`

```{r}
valueBox(format(n_up, big.mark = ","), icon = "fa-arrow-up", color = col_up)
```

### Down in `r ct_row$treatment` vs `r ct_row$control`

```{r}
valueBox(format(n_down, big.mark = ","), icon = "fa-arrow-down", color = col_down)
```

### Genes tested

```{r}
valueBox(format(nrow(d), big.mark = ","), icon = "fa-dna", color = "#636363")
```

```{r}
pd <- d |> mutate(neglog10 = round(-log10(pmax(P.Value, 1e-300)), 3), logFC = round(logFC, 3),
                  AveExpr = round(AveExpr, 3), FDR = signif(FDR, 3),
                  direction = factor(direction, levels = c("NS", "Down", "Up")))
ps <- sample_points(pd, pd$direction != "NS")
pd <- ps$df
```

Row {data-height=520}
-------------------------------------

### Volcano plot (`r de_rule``r ps$note`)

```{r}
plot_ly(pd, x = ~logFC, y = ~neglog10, color = ~direction,
        colors = c(NS = col_ns, Down = col_down, Up = col_up),
        text = ~gene_name, customdata = ~FDR, type = "scattergl", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.7),
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>logFC %{x:.2f}<br>FDR %{customdata:.2e}<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "log2 fold change"), yaxis = list(title = "-log10 p-value"),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", y = 1.08)) |>
    compact_plotly()
```

### MA plot`r ps$note`

```{r}
plot_ly(pd, x = ~AveExpr, y = ~logFC, color = ~direction,
        colors = c(NS = col_ns, Down = col_down, Up = col_up),
        text = ~gene_name, customdata = ~FDR, type = "scattergl", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.7),
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>mean log-CPM %{x:.2f}<br>logFC %{y:.2f}<br>FDR %{customdata:.2e}<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "Average log-CPM"), yaxis = list(title = "log2 fold change"),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", y = 1.08)) |>
    compact_plotly()
```

Row {data-height=600}
-------------------------------------

### Differentially expressed genes (`r de_rule`)

```{r}
sig <- d |> filter(direction != "NS") |> arrange(FDR) |>
    select(gene_id, gene_name, direction, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, FDR)
if (!nrow(sig)) {
    message_box(paste0("No genes pass ", de_rule, " for this contrast."))
} else {
    capped_table(sig, paste0(ct, "_DE_genes.tsv"),
                 numeric_cols = c("logFC", "AveExpr", "t"), sci_cols = c("P.Value", "FDR"))
}
```

Row {data-height=650}
-------------------------------------

### Top `r min(params$heatmap_top_n, n_up + n_down)` DE genes (row z-scores of voom log-CPM)

```{r}
top <- d |> filter(direction != "NS") |> arrange(FDR) |> head(params$heatmap_top_n)
hm_samples <- samples$sample[samples$condition %in% c(ct_row$treatment, ct_row$control)]
hm_samples <- intersect(hm_samples[order(samples$condition[match(hm_samples, samples$sample)] != ct_row$control)],
                        colnames(logcpm))
if (nrow(top) < 2 || is.null(logcpm) || length(hm_samples) < 2) {
    message_box("A heatmap needs at least two DE genes.")
} else {
    m <- logcpm[top$gene_id, hm_samples, drop = FALSE]
    z <- row_z(m)
    labels <- top$gene_name[match(rownames(z), top$gene_id)]
    x_lab  <- paste0(hm_samples, " (", sample_cond[hm_samples], ")")
    t_de   <- top[match(rownames(z), top$gene_id), ]
    txt <- matrix(paste0("<b>", rep(labels, ncol(z)), "</b><br>", rep(x_lab, each = nrow(z)),
                         "<br>log-CPM ", sprintf("%.2f", m), ", z = ", sprintf("%.2f", z),
                         "<br>log2FC ", sprintf("%.2f", rep(t_de$logFC, ncol(z))),
                         ", FDR ", rep(fmt_p(t_de$FDR), ncol(z))), nrow(z))
    # rows clustered by Euclidean distance of their z-score profiles (complete linkage)
    cluster_heatmap(z, x_lab, labels, txt, colorbar = list(title = list(text = "z", side = "top"),
                    orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom",
                    len = 0.4, thickness = 12))$plot |>
        layout(margin = list(b = 120, r = 10))
}
```
